items.headline: Reefs rebound after heatwave
summaries: Surveys find 40% more living coral than last year.
A Florida spawning method now runs in 11 countries.
Snapper have returned to reefs barren since 2016.
items.editorNote: One cooler year does not erase a hotter ocean. It does show restoration works when it is funded like infrastructure, not charity.

items.headline: Aquifers hit a historic low
summaries: The Ogallala Aquifer fell another four feet this year.
Twelve Plains counties have moved to emergency rationing.
Grain futures jumped 9% as irrigators idle fields.
items.editorNote: This is not a drought story. It is a drawdown story: we have been mining water that does not come back.

items.headline: Water summit flies private
summaries: Delegates arrived at the security forum on 47 private jets.
The host city banned lawn watering while banquet fountains ran.
The closing pledge skipped any cap on groundwater pumping.
items.editorNote: The people who named the crisis reserved the right to outrun it. The fountains were decorative. The aquifers are not.
